title: TwitchCon / Stage identity
slide_intent: Scale identity around a live gathering so audiences can orient themselves while the speaker remains visible.
strategic_value: A dominant TwitchCon signature and repeated side lettering can connect a large event to the platform.
demonstration: A wide stage photograph shows a large TwitchCon signature on the central screen, repeated text on side columns, purple lighting and a seated audience.
practical_value: Compare central identification with peripheral repetition in a large event environment.

content_islands.name: Central stage
content_islands.spec: Place the TwitchCon signature behind the speaker at the center of the stage.

content_islands.name: Side columns and light
content_islands.spec: Repeat event lettering on tall side displays and use purple lighting across the room.

content_islands.name: Audience foreground
content_islands.spec: Retain the seated crowd to communicate scale and viewing distance.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity appears on a live event stage, side displays and lighting.
